answer: Require every agent to stake a time-locked bond before it can vote or earn, so creating thousands of fake identities costs real capital instead of being free. Like a vine that can only grow where it has roots, an identity gains weight only through a verifiable history of useful work. A harbor that lets any ship dock without inspection invites smugglers; an economy that admits agents without cost invites sybils. Bonding makes the ocean of cheap aliases expensive to flood.
